headlines.title: Judge allows Paramount to close $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery
headlines.description: The deal brings together the likes of CBS News and CNN, HBO Max and Paramount+, and storied film studios Warner Bros. and Paramount Pictures.

headlines.title: Mortgage rates hit highest point since 2023 as Treasury yields rise
headlines.description: Mortgage rates are at their highest point in nearly three years as turmoil in the bond market continues.

headlines.title: Watchdog finds no criminality in Fed renovation that drew Trump’s scrutiny
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve’s watchdog said it found no grounds to believe federal law was violated in a project that drew criticism from President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: For the same ticket on StubHub, different prices for different people
headlines.description: NBC News volunteers saw eight different prices for the exact same Harry Styles ticket on StubHub. The company said it’s running random price experiments.

headlines.title: California voters back a billionaire tax, but the proposal falls short of majority support
headlines.description: A new NBCUniversal Local/Telemundo Station Group shows “yes” supporters leading 48% to 38% on the California ballot measure.

headlines.title: Inside Look at How Retailers Use Your Data for ‘Price Experiments’
headlines.description: Across retail, travel, food and more, some companies are charging consumers different prices for the same products and services. Lindsay Owens, author of the new book “Gouged: The End of a Fair Price and What That Menas for Your Wallet,” says companies overcharge by using “price experiments” where they change randomly between customers and some also use “surveillance or personalized pricing” where they charge prices based on your data all to increase profits. headlines.title: Consumer Hot Topics: Spam Calls, Credit Safety and More
headlines.description: NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to answer viewer questions on everything from spam calls to travel insurance.

headlines.title: Money-Saving Strategies as Grocery Price Wars Get Underway
headlines.description: Food prices are higher overall this year, but now major chains including Aldi, Walmart, Target and Amazon, are offering deals to lure customers back. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with how to maximize your savings at the checkout line. Tips include using cash back apps, joining loyalty clubs, shopping in-season and local fruits and vegetables, and more.

headlines.title: Mortgage Rates Hit Highest Level in More Than 2 Years
headlines.description: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate is averaging 7.45%, its highest level in more than two years, making it even harder for Americans to jump into the housing market. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down why rates are rising and what it means for borrowers and savers.

headlines.title: Should you bring iced coffee to a job interview? Question brews generational debate
headlines.description: What started as a conversation about job interview tips online escalated into a generational debate over whether it’s taboo to show up with an iced coffee to talk to a potential employer.

headlines.title: The U.S. economy before and after the Iran war, in five charts
headlines.description: Nearly seven months in, the conflict now casts a cloud of uncertainty — with no end in sight.

headlines.title: Trump unveils plans for a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa
headlines.description: Mesabi Metallics, which is building the plant, aims to start production in 2030, a White House official said.
